description:
`benchbox submit --dry-run` exited 0 for
`amplab_sf001_clickhouse_local_sql_20260502_185809_f2e17de5.json`, but the
same packaged bundle later failed `scripts/validate_submission.py` because of
the normalized-cost contract. This contradicts the hosted-results contract
text that says dry-run runs client-side validations.

anti_patterns.instead: share or call the same validation rules where practical.

preserves.behavior: Dry-run remains offline/local and does not upload results.
Valid result dry-runs still show the PR-ready package preview.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests -k 'submit and dry_run and validation' -q
verifications.description: Dry-run rejects a known invalid bundle with the same validator error class.
verifications.expected: selected submit dry-run validation tests pass

verifications.description: Submission validator still accepts valid bundles.

work_units.notes:
Research 2026-05-03:
- UAT evidence:
  `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/amplab_sf001_clickhouse_local_sql_20260502_185809_f2e17de5.json`
  and the packaged copy under
  `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/submissions/uat_20260502/bundle/`
  reproduce the drift.
- `uv run -- python scripts/validate_submission.py <packaged-bundle>` exits
  1 with `Public leaderboard cost totals require normalized cost availability:
  cost.total_usd cannot accompany cost_status 'unavailable'`.
- `uv run -- benchbox submit <result> --dry-run --output /tmp/benchbox-submit-dryrun-check`
  exits 0 and prints the PR-package preview; the dry-run writes no output
  files.
- `uv run -- benchbox submit <result> --dry-run --service` exits 0 and
  prints the hosted upload preview with no credentials.
- Divergence owner: `benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` returns from both
  dry-run paths before running the shared `scripts.validate_submission`
  rules. The validator already owns the publish-blocking bundle contract;
  do not duplicate it.
- Database cleanup checkpoint: this work unit created no database outputs.
  The only database-tree artifact was an empty
  `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/databases/flightdata_sf1` directory,
  which was pruned. Reusable datagen under
  `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/datagen` is preserved because it is
  shared across benchmarks such as TPC-H/read-primitives reuse.
work_units.summary: Compare submit dry-run validation with scripts/validate_submission.py
